Name: Pre-release Elliott (Content Patcher) (1.5.6)
Author: SEISHI112
Description:
[center][b][size=5]/!\ NOT compatible with 1.6 [i]yet,[/i] I turned it visible again for people playing or staying on [i]1.5.6[/i] /!\[/size][/b][/center]_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

I've been interested in Elliott for quite a while, after finding some bachelors and bachelorettes to not be what I expected. I like slightly older muscular guys with long hair that show some intelligence, but like most players, I couldn't get myself to like Elliott's side-facing portrait.

Ever since I tried to give him a chance, I had been using many portrait replacement mods I could find that I liked; yet other people made him either too young looking or a completely different character. I wanted to lower some of his "Fabiosity" while having him fit with (mostly) the rest of the townsfolk.

[b]So I went ahead and made my own portraits[/b], creating a complete spritesheet for one of his older looking pre-release sprites + some more edits over time.

There are [b]three[/b] versions now, this time version-based on the edits I made and not the dumb names I gave them before.

[b][size=3]CHOOSE ONE AND USE ONLY ONE AT A TIME.
[/size][size=2]All this "mod" does is replace 2 images from the game, so yeah, it won't work if you use another portrait mod for Elliot at the same time.[/size][/b]

Install by downloading the version you want, place it in your Mods folder, and extract it there. Content Patcher needed.

Downloads.Description: Ears, part of the hair falling on the shoulders, some eyes, and great part of the surprised sprite were retouched. Main sprites were modified from 1.1, while beach sprites had the 1.1 heads pasted to retouched 1.0 bodies.

Manifest.Name: Non Side-Facing Slightly Older Elliott (New)
Manifest.Description: Replaces Elliott's portraits with a set based on one of his pre-release versions.
